The original RAG paper ([1]) proposes two generator models: **RAG-Sequence** and **RAG-Token**, which differ in how they marginalize over retrieved documents when generating text. It also evaluates against BART as a baseline.

The MedRAG benchmark ([2]) evaluates the following LLMs: **GPT-4**, **GPT-3.5**, **Mixtral (8×7B)**, **Llama2 (70B)**, **MEDTRON (70B)**, and **PMC-LLaMA (13B)**.
